query:
SELECT 
  b.id as booking_id,
  b.mentorId,
  b.studentId,
  b.status,
  b.consultationType,
  b.scheduledAt,
  u_mentor.id as mentor_user_id,
  u_mentor.name as mentor_name,
  mp.id as mentor_profile_id,
  mp.userId as mp_userId,
  u_student.id as student_user_id,
  u_student.name as student_name
FROM bookings b
LEFT JOIN mentor_profiles mp ON b.mentorId = mp.id
LEFT JOIN users u_mentor ON mp.userId = u_mentor.id
LEFT JOIN users u_student ON b.studentId = u_student.id
ORDER BY b.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
